main_theorems.name: CK.infoP
main_theorems.statement: def infoP {k : ℕ} (π : Cube k → ℝ) : ℝ := binaryEntropy (avg π) - avg (fun u => binaryEntropy (π u))

main_theorems.name: CK.avg_noisy
main_theorems.statement: theorem avg_noisy {k : ℕ} {p : ℝ} (π : Cube k → ℝ) : avg (noisy p π) = avg π

main_theorems.name: CK.infoP_noisy_le
main_theorems.statement: theorem infoP_noisy_le {k : ℕ} {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1 / 2) {π : Cube k → ℝ} (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ π u) (h1 : ∀ u, π u ≤ 1) : infoP (noisy p π) ≤ (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2 * infoP π

main_theorems.name: CK.posterior_eq_noisy
main_theorems.statement: theorem posterior_eq_noisy {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) (p : ℝ) : posterior f p = noisy p (fun x => indicator (f x))

main_theorems.name: CK.information_le_contraction
main_theorems.statement: theorem information_le_contraction {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1 / 2) : information f p ≤ (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2 * binaryEntropy (mean f)

main_theorems.name: CK.kernel_compose
main_theorems.statement: theorem kernel_compose {n : ℕ} (p0 p' : ℝ) (y x : Cube n) : (∑ z : Cube n, kernel p' y z * kernel p0 z x) = kernel (p0 + p' - 2 * p0 * p') y x

main_theorems.name: CK.noisy_noisy
main_theorems.statement: theorem noisy_noisy {k : ℕ} (p0 p' : ℝ) (π : Cube k → ℝ) : noisy p' (noisy p0 π) = noisy (p0 + p' - 2 * p0 * p') π

main_theorems.name: CK.information_degrade
main_theorems.statement: theorem information_degrade {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction n) {p0 p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p0) (hp0' : p0 < 1 / 2) (hpp : p0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1 / 2) : information f p ≤ ((1 - 2 * p) / (1 - 2 * p0)) ^ 2 * information f p0

main_theorems.name: CK.conditionalEntropy_ge_conditional
main_theorems.statement: theorem conditionalEntropy_ge_conditional {n : ℕ} (f : BooleanFunction (n + 1)) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1 / 2) : (1 - (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2) * pairEntropy (2 * mean f - 1) ((1 - 2 * p) * (mean (sectionLast f true) - mean (sectionLast f false))) + (1 - 2 * p) ^ 2 * avg (fun w => if sectionLast f true w = sectionLast f false w then (0 : ℝ) else binaryEntropy p) ≤ conditionalEntropy f p
